pageTitle: Semana 4: Mi primera clase de cocina española
chapterTitle: Mi primera clase de cocina española

extraLinks.label: 💬 Practica las conversaciones de esta semana →

blocks.es: Hola, me llamo Marina, tengo 27 años.
blocks.en: Hello, my name is Marina.

blocks.es: Esta es mi primera [[clase_de_cocina|clase de cocina]] española.
blocks.en: This is my first Spanish cooking class.

blocks.es: Vivo en Madrid, en un piso pequeño.
blocks.en: I live in Madrid, in a small flat.

blocks.es: Hoy es sábado, son las 10 de la mañana.
blocks.en: It is 10 in the morning.

blocks.es: El cielo está claro y hace buen tiempo.
blocks.en: The sky is clear and the weather is good.
I get my mustard-colored bag ready.

blocks.es: Llevo un [[cuaderno|cuaderno]], un lápiz y mi móvil.
blocks.en: I take a notebook, a pencil, and my phone.

blocks.es: Estoy un poco nerviosa, pero también contenta.
blocks.en: I am a little nervous, but also happy.

blocks.es: Salgo de casa y camino por el barrio.
blocks.en: I leave home and walk through the neighbourhood.
The streets are dry.
There is sun.

blocks.es: Llego a una cocina grande y luminosa.
blocks.en: I arrive at a big, bright kitchen.
There are other people.
They smile.
I go in with my bag.
Here I am.

blocks.es: La profesora nos saluda con una sonrisa.
blocks.en: The teacher greets us with a smile.
Today we are making a Spanish potato omelette.

blocks.es: Sobre la mesa hay [[huevo|huevos]], patatas, cebolla y aceite de oliva.
blocks.en: On the table there are eggs, potatoes, onion and olive oil.
I look at the teacher.
Okay, I'm starting.
I put on a white apron.

blocks.es: Primero me lavo las manos con agua y jabón.
blocks.en: First, I wash my hands with soap and water.

blocks.es: Corto las patatas y la cebolla.
blocks.en: I cut the potatoes and the onion.
Slowly.

blocks.es: La profesora mira el aceite en la [[sarten|sartén]].
blocks.en: The teacher watches the oil in the pan.

blocks.es: El aceite está caliente, pero está bien.
blocks.en: The oil is hot, but it is fine.

blocks.es: Pongo las patatas en la sartén.
blocks.en: I put the potatoes in the pan.
Everything smells good.
The potatoes cook slowly.
I talk with a classmate.
Her name is Laura.

blocks.es: Laura también es nueva en la clase.
blocks.en: Laura is also new in the class.
I am not so nervous now.
I turn it over.

blocks.es: La tortilla se parte un poco y un trozo se separa en el [[plato|plato]].
blocks.en: The omelette breaks a little and a piece separates on the plate.
What a mess.
The omelette is not perfect.
The teacher smiles.
It's no problem.

blocks.es: Pongo la tortilla otra vez en la sartén.
blocks.en: I put the omelette back in the pan.
We cook it a little more.

blocks.es: Por fin, la tortilla está dorada.
blocks.en: At last, the omelette is golden.

blocks.es: No es redonda, pero está hecha.
blocks.en: It is not round, but it is cooked.
I laugh a little.
Laura laughs too.
I am happy.
The class is fun.

blocks.es: Nos sentamos juntos en una mesa larga.
blocks.en: We sit together at a long table.
The teacher cuts the omelette.
I try a piece.
It is amazing.
It is hot and very tasty.
I eat with my new friends.
I feel good.

blocks.es: Después de la clase escribo en mi cuaderno.
blocks.en: After the class, I write in my notebook.
I jot down the new words.
Laura says to me, see you soon.
I smile.
I want another class.

blocks.es: Esta cocina ya no es un sitio extraño.
blocks.en: This kitchen is not a strange place now.

blocks.es: Por la tarde vuelvo a casa sin prisa.
blocks.en: In the afternoon, I go back home without hurry.
The sun is low.
The neighbourhood is quiet.

blocks.es: Llevo mi bolsa de color mostaza y mi cuaderno.
blocks.en: I carry my mustard-colored bag and my notebook.

blocks.es: Pienso en la tortilla y en mis amigos.
blocks.en: I think about the omelette and about my friends.

blocks.es: En el piso me siento junto a la ventana.
blocks.en: In the flat, I sit by the window.
I open the notebook again.

blocks.es: Pienso, la tortilla no es perfecta.
blocks.en: The omelette is not perfect.
I think, the omelette is not perfect, and that's okay.

blocks.es: Cocinar con amigos también es bonito.
blocks.en: Cooking with friends is also lovely.

blocks.es: Hoy aprendo algo nuevo en Madrid.
blocks.en: Today, I learned something new in Madrid.
I am tired, but very happy.

blocks.es: Esta es mi primera clase de cocina española.
blocks.en: This is my first Spanish cooking class.

grammar.body:
